ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The room floor plan in the figure is a stepped polygon composed of horizontal and vertical line segments. Along the stepped edge from the top to the lower right, three horizontal wall segments to the right can be seen, all labeled a; the three vertical wall segments downward are labeled b, 2b, and b respectively. On the left side there is a vertical wall with no length labeled, and at the bottom there is a horizontal wall with no length labeled. Reasoning: Because this is a closed orthogonal polygon, the length of the unlabeled horizontal wall at the bottom must equal the sum of all horizontal displacements to the right, namely a+a+a=3a. The length of the unlabeled vertical wall on the left must equal the sum of all vertical displacements downward, namely b+2b+b=4b. The perimeter equals the sum of all side lengths. The total length of horizontal sides is a+a+a+3a=6a; the total length of vertical sides is b+2b+b+4b=8b. Therefore the perimeter of the room is 6a+8b.

method.method_draft: Read the room outline as an orthogonal staircase polygon. From the image, the three rightward horizontal wall segments are each labeled a, and the three downward vertical wall segments are labeled b, 2b, and b. The unlabeled bottom horizontal wall must equal the total rightward horizontal displacement, so it is a+a+a=3a. The unlabeled left vertical wall must equal the total downward vertical displacement, so it is b+2b+b=4b. Add all boundary segments: horizontal total is a+a+a+3a=6a, vertical total is b+2b+b+4b=8b, giving perimeter 6a+8b.

method.method_draft: View the stepped outline as fitting inside a bounding rectangle whose top-left corner is the top-left corner of the room and whose bottom-right corner is the bottom-right corner of the room. From the image, moving along the staircase from top-left to bottom-right accumulates horizontal distance a+a+a=3a and vertical distance b+2b+b=4b. Therefore the bounding rectangle has width 3a and height 4b. For this monotone stair-step boundary, the stair path from top-left to bottom-right has length 3a+4b, and the other two outer sides, bottom and left, also total 3a+4b. Thus the room perimeter is 2(3a+4b)=6a+8b.
